LESSON: USE OF SOCIAL MEDIA

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Morality and Social Media
Topic 6.1: Use of Social Media

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Use of Social Media. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you use social media appropriately?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss appropriate ways of using social media
2. apply the value of integrity when using social media

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: USE OF SOCIAL MEDIA
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Use of Social Media helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: USE OF SOCIAL MEDIA
Study Use of Social Media like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Discuss appropriate ways of using social media

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss appropriate ways of using social media. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss appropriate ways of using social media.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Use of Social Media” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss appropriate ways of using social media. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Apply the value of integrity when using social media

What this means
In this part you learn to apply the value of integrity when using social media. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply the value of integrity when using social media.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Use of Social Media in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply the value of integrity when using social media. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Use of Social Media is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Use of Social Media” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: discuss appropriate ways of using social media)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Use of Social Media in your own words. (skill: apply the value of integrity when using social media)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Use of Social Media to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: discuss appropriate ways of using social media.
3. Practise this skill: apply the value of integrity when using social media.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Use of Social Media from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Use of Social Media: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Use of Social Media?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you use social media appropriately?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Use of Social Media means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: discuss appropriate ways of using social media.
5. Be able to: apply the value of integrity when using social media.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
